questions.stem: Which of the following is a core technique that enabled the birth of modern biotechnology?
choices: Genetic engineering
Photosynthesis
Respiration
Fermentation
questions.solution: Genetic engineering is the correct answer because it involves the direct manipulation of an organism's genes, which is fundamental to modern biotechnology. Photosynthesis, respiration, and fermentation are natural biological processes but do not involve the targeted modification of genetic material, which is essential for biotechnology.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी मुख्य तकनीक आधुनिक जैव प्रौद्योगिकी के जन्म के लिए अनिवार्य रही?

questions.stem: What is the term used for the specific sequence in a chromosome that allows an alien DNA to replicate?
choices: Origin of replication
Recombinant DNA
Restriction enzyme
Vector
questions.solution: The term for the specific sequence in a chromosome that allows an alien DNA to replicate is the 'origin of replication' because it is the site where DNA replication begins. 'Recombinant DNA' refers to DNA that has been combined from different sources, 'restriction enzyme' is an enzyme that cuts DNA at specific locations, and 'vector' is a tool used to carry DNA into a host cell.

hi.stem: एक क्रोमोसोम में विशिष्ट अनुक्रम के लिए क्या शब्द प्रयोग किया जाता है जो एक विदेशी डीएनए के प्रतिकृति बनाने की अनुमति देता है?

hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as used in Hindi biology textbooks.

'पुनर्जनित DNA' हा विविध स्रोतांमधून जोडलेल्या DNA ला संदर्भित करते, 'सीमानियंत्रक एंजाइम' हा विशिष्ट स्थानांवर DNA कापणारा एंजाइम आहे आणि 'वेक्टर' हा हॉस्ट सेलमध्ये DNA वाहून नेण्यासाठी वापरल्या जाणार्‍या उपकरणाचे नाव आहे.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of using bioreactors in biotechnology?
choices: To store raw materials for future use
To increase the yield of desired proteins
To prevent the growth of unwanted microorganisms
To reduce the cost of biotechnology processes
questions.solution: The main purpose of using bioreactors is to increase the yield of desired proteins. Bioreactors provide optimal conditions for cell growth and protein production, allowing for large-scale manufacturing. Storing raw materials is not their main function, preventing microorganism growth is not their primary purpose, and reducing costs is not the main reason for using them.

questions.stem: What is a bioreactor primarily used for?
choices: To store biological samples
To control the temperature of the environment
To carry out large-scale production of biological products
To mix different chemicals
questions.solution: A bioreactor is primarily used to carry out large-scale production of biological products. It provides the optimal conditions for producing the desired protein. Storing samples, controlling temperature, and mixing chemicals are not its main functions.

questions.stem: What is the primary function of restriction enzymes in recombinant DNA technology?
choices: To replicate DNA
To cut DNA at specific sites
To join DNA fragments
To insert DNA into a host
questions.solution: The primary function of restriction enzymes is to cut DNA at specific sites. They are not used for replication, joining, or insertion.

questions.stem: In the process of recombinant DNA technology, what is the role of a plasmid?

questions.stem: If a foreign DNA is inserted into the tetracycline resistance gene of a plasmid, what will happen to the bacteria that take up the recombinant plasmid?
choices: They will not grow on ampicillin
They will not grow on tetracycline
They will grow on both antibiotics
They will not grow on either antibiotic
